text: frequency Numeric. Spatial scale noise pattern. Lower values produce broad, smooth bands; higher values produce finer, maze-like structures (default: 3). veg_threshold Numeric. Threshold separating vegetated bare cells (0-1, default: 0.5). Values become vegetation. Lower thresholds increase vegetation cover; higher thresholds reduce . band_fuzziness Numeric. Zero gives deterministic boundaries; values around 0.05 0.1 add slight irregularities largely preserving topology. Higher values may fragment bands, values roughly 0.3 can appear increasingly random rather maze-like. octaves Integer. Number noise layers combined continuous field (least 1, default: 2). One octave emphasizes smooth, large-scale structure. Two three add fine-scale variation preserving dominant wavelength. Higher values add fractal-like detail can obscure bands.
